'''Ah Ah Kung''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who is mentioned during [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is a member of the [[San Fierro Triads|Triads]].

==Character history==
Ah Ah Kung, at an unknown time, joined the [[San Fierro Triads|Triads]] based in [[San Fierro]] and by [[1992]] lived in Kowloon, Hong Kong, China. He [[Ran Fa Li (mission)|informs]] Triad [[Gang Leaders|Dai Dai Lo]] [[Wu Zi Mu]] of the Vietnamese gang, the [[Da Nang Boys]], and their plans to move to [[San Fierro]] and across [[United States of America|America]].
